lines.text: You're here, sunshine. My colleagues reported zero anomalies in their respective areas.
I thought it was a false alarm...
But no! I arrived at Fangxing Avenue this morning and found the place in a great mess! Even the Chubby Lungs weren't spared!
It must be Grimy Mucker! Nothing else could get so high.

options: What happened to the Chubby Lungs?
Maybe later. I gotta take care of something.

r: What happened to the Chubby Lungs?

lines.text: The Chubby Lungs are as good as new. Thank you so much!
While you were cleaning, I found strange footprints with feathers stuck to them...
But I'll hear what you found about the stains on the Chubby Lungs.
Fowlbeasts again? But ... the show told us Grimy Mucker never uses the same trick twice...
Hmm. I believe I have been misled. This isn't the work of Grimy Mucker. It's the Circle of Beast Whisperers!
Have you watched Unsolved Mysteries of Talos-II?
One of the episodes talked about them. A secret circle of casters who know how to control beasts. They worked from the shadows in many historical events...
These poor critters must have been secretly controlled by the Whisperers to achieve evil and mischief!
We can't let this go on. I shall track these footprints and investigate.
But a team of two is too conspicuous. The mischievous pranksters will be spooked...
No, sunshine. I'll do this alone. I am a veteran Sanitation Worker. Such footprints won't escape my eyes...
You have a heart of gold, sunshine. I'll toast you a message if I find something!
Misbehaving pantails, burdenbeasts that rolled in the mud, fowlbeasts that soiled the Marker Stone...

options: What is the Circle of Beast Whisperers...?
You're not doing this alone. It sounds dangerous.

r: What is the Circle of Beast Whisperers...?
You're not doing this alone. It sounds dangerous.

lines.text: Yes, you're right. We clean up the mega-beans and see if there are any clues nearby...
How dare it spoil the best landmark of Fangxing Avenue...! The Urban Sanitation Team will make it pay!

options: Our priority is to clean up the Chubby Lungs.
Look how they messed up the Chubby Lung.

r: Look how they messed up the Chubby Lung.
Our priority is to clean up the Chubby Lungs.
